name: Leopold Aschenbrenner

moves.name: Vistra

moves.name: Vertiv
moves.note: New position in thermal and power management for AI data centres.

moves.name: CoreWeave
moves.note: Starter position in contracted neocloud capacity.

name: Philippe Laffont
strategy: Crossover technology fund blending public and private exposure; leans into platform shifts early and sizes up as evidence compounds.

moves.name: Nvidia

name: Cathie Wood
strategy: Thematic open-ended funds targeting disruptive innovation across robotics, space, and autonomous systems. ARK publishes daily trades, so 13F snapshots lag the live book.

moves.name: Tesla

moves.name: Rocket Lab

moves.name: Palantir

moves.name: Teradyne

moves.name: IonQ
moves.note: Initial quantum hardware exposure across several funds.

name: Warren Buffett
strategy: Long-horizon value investing in businesses with durable moats; technology exposure arrives late and only at scale. The 13F covers the equity portfolio, not operating subsidiaries such as Berkshire Hathaway Energy's grid assets.

moves.name: Apple
moves.note: Continued multi-quarter trim of the largest holding.

moves.name: Alphabet
moves.note: Added to the position first disclosed in late 2025; a rare mega-cap technology add.

name: Michael Burry
strategy: Contrarian value with episodic macro hedges; uses index and single-name options to express bearish views. Option positions on a 13F report notional value, which overstates economic exposure.

moves.name: Nvidia
moves.note: Reported as put options - a bearish expression on AI capex sustainability, not a long position.

moves.name: Palantir
moves.note: Also reported as put options; pairs with the Nvidia hedge as a crowding signal.

moves.name: Estee Lauder
moves.note: Long equity position away from the AI trade.

moves.name: Alibaba
moves.note: Closed the long China position held in prior quarters.

name: Renaissance Technologies
strategy: Systematic quantitative trading across thousands of names; positions turn over rapidly and reflect statistical signals rather than fundamental theses, so quarter-end snapshots are weak evidence of conviction.

moves.name: Nvidia
moves.note: Signal-driven; sizing changes frequently between filings.

moves.name: Uranium Energy
moves.note: One of several small uranium-cycle positions in the model book.

moves.name: Super Micro Computer
moves.note: Exited; typical holding periods run weeks to months.

name: Stanley Druckenmiller
strategy: Macro-driven equity book that rotates aggressively around inflection points; has favoured power, copper, and nuclear as second-derivative expressions of the AI trade.

moves.name: Freeport-McMoRan
moves.note: Copper exposure tied to grid and electrification demand.

moves.name: Vistra
moves.note: Added to the power-generation position as data-centre PPAs accelerated.

moves.name: Cameco
moves.note: Uranium fuel-cycle exposure as nuclear restarts gain policy support.

moves.name: MP Materials

name: Baillie Gifford

moves.name: ASML
